task_completion.description: The Weasis DICOM viewer is open and a CT scan is loaded in the main viewport.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Weasis application window is visible with medical imaging data (CT scan) displayed in the central viewing area.

task_completion.description: The agent accesses the display settings or right-click menu to change interpolation.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A context menu or settings panel is visible showing interpolation options (e.g., Bicubic, Bilinear, Nearest Neighbor).

task_completion.description: The display interpolation is explicitly set to 'Nearest' or 'Nearest Neighbor'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Nearest' or 'Nearest Neighbor' option is selected/checked in the menu, or the image rendering appears noticeably 'blocky' rather than smooth.

task_completion.description: The view is zoomed in to at least 400% on a specific structure.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The zoom indicator in the Weasis UI (usually in the corner of the view or status bar) shows a value of 400% or higher.

task_completion.description: The agent initiates the export process for the current view.
task_completion.visual_evidence: An 'Export' or 'Save As' dialog box is visible over the Weasis interface.

task_completion.description: The image is saved to the specific path ~/DICOM/exports/nearest_neighbor.png.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The file browser or export dialog shows the path /home/ga/DICOM/exports/ and the filename nearest_neighbor.png before confirmation.

integrity.description: The agent used the Weasis GUI to change settings and export, rather than just using terminal commands to move files.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse cursor movement, menu selections, and the Weasis export dialog, not just a terminal window.

integrity.description: The image in the viewer shows the characteristic 'pixelated' look of Nearest Neighbor interpolation at high zoom.
integrity.visual_evidence: The CT scan pixels appear as sharp, distinct squares (blocks) rather than blurred or smoothed gradients.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply find an existing file and rename it.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen navigating the Weasis menus to perform the 'Export' action manually.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires 'Nearest Neighbor' interpolation at >400% zoom. This specific combination results in a 'blocky' visual appearance where at least 25% of adjacent pixels are identical. The final output must be saved exactly to /home/ga/DICOM/exports/nearest_neighbor.png. The source DICOM is synthetic noise/gradients, so if the image looks smooth at 400% zoom, the agent failed to set the interpolation to Nearest Neighbor.
